patterns.note: Generous vertical spacing between full-width content sections, often with alternating background colors to delineate content blocks.
Prominent, friendly sans-serif typography for headings and hero text, contrasted with smaller, readable sans-serif for body content and uppercase labels for section titles.
A core palette of light blue, dark grey, and white, frequently accented by vibrant, character-driven illustrations that introduce a broader range of playful colors.

A sticky header remains visible on scroll. The hero illustration features a subtle parallax effect, scrolling slower than the foreground text. A horizontal text ticker creates a continuous scrolling effect for location information.
Portfolio sections utilize a flexible grid system, adapting from three to six columns for project previews, each with a title below.
The footer features a unique, wavy-edged call-to-action button, breaking from the site's otherwise subtle corner radii.

technique_notes: Implement a sticky header that maintains its position at the top of the viewport. The hero section employs a background element that scrolls at a slower rate than the foreground content, creating a subtle parallax effect for the main illustration. A horizontally scrolling text container with duplicated content creates a continuous, infinite loop for location tags.

Integrate custom, character-driven illustrations as primary visual elements, often occupying significant screen real estate in hero sections and as section dividers, to convey a playful and approachable brand personality. Utilize a clean, spacious layout with ample padding and a consistent grid system for displaying content, maintaining visual hierarchy and readability.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, friendly sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) with a clear hierarchy, complemented by smaller, readable body text and uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding for buttons and image containers, with mostly sharp edges for overall layout, but a distinctive wavy shape for the primary call-to-action button.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy, especially in the hero and between major sections, creating a sense of calm and focus; content within grids is balanced.

standout: The distinctive, playful, character-driven illustrations are central to the brand identity and are integrated throughout the site, giving it a unique, approachable, and memorable feel that goes beyond typical portfolio sites. The custom wavy 'Get in Touch' button also adds a unique touch of personality.
